content.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
content.body:
We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss.

The loss scales as a power-law with [highlight]model size[/highlight], dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude.
